articles.title: 消息称 OPPO Reno 17 系列新机销量超预期，开售后超同期安卓手机拿下单品第一
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，博主 @数码闲聊站 昨晚发文分享第三方渠道消息，OPPO Reno 17 销量超预期，发布当日预订量达前代产品 2.7 倍，开售后销量超过同期所有安卓手机，拿下安卓单品第一。博主还补充数据：Reno 系列全球激活量已超 1.4 亿台，长期稳居同档位销量前列。据IT之家此前报道，OPPO Reno 17 系列手机已于 11 月 20 日正式开售，Pro 版机型搭载天玑 8550 处理器，标准版搭载骁龙 7 Gen4 处理器，主打“全焦段 4K 超清长实况”拍摄，售价 3599 元起、国补价 3099 元起。京东 OPPO Reno 17 国补 3099 元起直达链接京东 OPPO Reno 17 Pro 国补 3699 元起直达链接2026 年数码家电政府补贴持续进行中，IT 之家为大家汇总国补领券地址，买数码家电之前记得领取。数码补贴：点此领券手机 / 平板 / 3C 数码支持 8.5 折政府补贴，不超过 6000 元的产品至高立减 500 元。家电补贴：点此领券多类家电支持 8.5 折政府补贴，单品至高补贴 1500 元。延伸阅读综合多方信息，OPPO 于 2026 年 11 月 16 日在成都举办 Reno 17 系列新品发布会，推出 Reno 17 和 Reno 17 Pro 两款机型。具体配置上，Reno 17 Pro 采用 6.32 英寸小屏，内置 7250mAh 电池；Reno 17 采用 6.56 英寸屏幕，内置 8000mAh 电池。影像方面，Reno 17 标准版配备 5000 万像素前摄，以及由 5000 万像素主摄、超广角、潜望长焦组成的超清四摄；Reno 17 Pro 则配备 2 亿像素主摄、5000 万像素超广角与 5000 万像素潜望长焦。此外，该系列全系支持 IP69K 防水，搭载 ColorOS 17 系统。文中提到的天玑 8550 处理器于 2026 年 5 月发布，采用台积电 4nm N4P 工艺制程，CPU 为全大核 Cortex-A725 架构，由 1 颗 3.4GHz 超大核、3 颗 3.2GHz 大核及 4 颗 2.2GHz 小核组成，GPU 为 Mali-G720 MC8，最高支持 LPDDR5X 9600Mbps 内存与 UFS 4.0 闪存。另有数据显示，截至 2026 年 10 月，Reno 系列年销量突破 565 万台，拿下同档位销量冠军；天猫平台数据显示，Reno 17 购机用户中 30 岁以下年轻人占比近半。

articles.title: 今日小雪：雨凝为雪，地气冻结
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 22 日消息，今天是 11 月 22 日，同时也是节气中的小雪，真正的寒冬即将到来。小雪为二十四节气中的第 20 个。具体的时间为 11 月 22 或 23 日，此时太阳到达黄经 240°。小雪时节①天气寒冷，降水状态由雨变雪，但“地寒未甚”，雪量不大，故称小雪；②北方供暖季，长期在暖气房会出现口干舌燥、咳嗽、头晕等，需预防“暖气病”；③小雪节气过后气温将更低，要注意防寒保暖，谨防感冒。小雪到，冬始俏。进入该节气，中国广大地区西北风开始成为常客，气温下降，虽开始降雪，但雪量不大，故称小雪。据说，在北方，小雪时节要吃涮羊肉，在南方有吃糍粑的习俗。小雪节气的降临就意味着西北风的到来，同时各地气温也逐渐降到 0℃ 以下。此时大地尚未彻底寒冷，下降的雪也不是很多，故名小雪。对于黄河以北的人们来说，冬天的第一场雪就将在小雪节气附近降临，小雪的到来也提醒着人们该御寒保暖。何谓小雪《月令七十二候集解》曰：“10 月中，雨下而为寒气所薄，故凝而为雪。小者未盛之辞。”小雪是反映天气现象的节令。古籍《群芳谱》中说：“小雪气寒而将雪矣，地寒未甚而雪未大也。”我国古代将小雪分为三候：“一候虹藏不见；二候天气上升地气下降；三候闭塞而成冬。”由于天空中的阳气上升，地中的阴气下降，导致天地不通，阴阳不交，所以万物失去生机，天地闭塞而转入严寒的冬天。小雪习俗贮藏蔬菜小雪来临，东北的土地开始冻结，土壤冻结深度可以达到 10 厘米，于是在北方地区，果农开始为果树修枝，以草秸编箔包扎株杆，以防果树受冻。农民们在收获前十天停止浇水做好防冻工作，另外尽量选择天晴的时候进行收获。天冷时多覆盖白菜叶和玉米杆防冻，待到可以食用的时候便已经成熟。饮食习俗在我国的南方部分地区还有农历十月吃糍粑的习俗。在古代，糍粑是南方地区传统的节日祭品，最早是农民用来祭牛神的供品。在小雪到来的时候选择吃糍粑可以平衡阴阳，但进食过多高热量的补品，会导致胃、肺火盛。因此还应该再吃一些性冷的食物，如萝卜、松花蛋。保健养生起居在冬季，早睡晚起，不要熬夜。起居要做好御寒保暖，防止感冒的发生。白天注意开窗通风。每天晚上要在 10 点上床，最好用热水泡泡脚，并按摩足底的涌泉穴。饮食小雪节气，宜吃温性食物和益肾的食品。温性食物有核桃、葡萄、栗子、鸡、虾、生姜、胡椒等；益肾食品有腰果、山药、芡实、紫米粥、白果、核桃等。另外，要多吃黑色食品如黑木耳、黑芝麻、黑豆等。就是说，要远“三白”：糖、盐、猪油；还要近“三黑”：第一个是木耳，第二个叫紫菜、还有一个是紫米，三个黑的对人比较好，这就是养生专家推荐的远“三白”、近“三黑”。运动小雪节气中，天气时常是阴冷晦暗，绿色植被和红色花卉减少，此时人们的心情也会受其影响，特别容易引发抑郁症，所以应调节自己的心态，保持乐观，经常参加一些户外活动以增强体质。关于小雪的谚语节到小雪天下雪。小雪节到下大雪，大雪节到没了雪。小雪封地，大雪封河。小雪地不封，大雪还能耕。小雪不把棉柴拔，地冻镰砍就剩茬。小雪不起菜（白菜），就要受冻害。小雪不砍菜，必定有一害。趁地未封冻，赶快把树种。大地未冻结，栽树不能歇。夹雨夹雪，无休无歇。小雪封地地不封，老汉继续把地耕。以上部分资料来源于百科等互联网本文参考IT之家 2017 年 11 月 22 日文章：《今日小雪：天寒地燥，注意保暖》，略有修改。

articles.title: 1967 款保时捷 912 借电动化喜获新生：输出 304 马力，续航 400 公里
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，现如今在海外，让经典车通过电动化改造获得新生的项目不断涌现。外媒 insideevs 今天（21 日）介绍了一辆“复活”的 1967 款保时捷 912，该车由改装厂商 Inverted 经手，改装团队为它装上了电池组和电动机。改装完成后，车辆外观与原厂 912 毫无二致，经典的复古造型得以完整保留，开起来却已经是一辆当代的电动汽车。这套改装最巧妙的地方在于电池布局。由于车身本就轻巧，62kWh 的电池组因此足以让车辆拥有相当可观的续航。然而，电池重量如果全部集中在后轴上方，却会让车尾负担过重。老款风冷保时捷本来就容易在收油时出现转向过度，再增加后部重量，自然不是好主意。Inverted 为此将电池组拆分成两部分：一部分放在原发动机舱的位置，另一部分则安装在车头的前备箱内。经过这样的布局调整，电动版 912 的前后重量分配反而比原车更加合理。IT之家从报道中获悉，车辆续航约为 400km，支持 75kW 直流快充。对于当下的电动汽车来说，这样的充电功率算不上突出，不过考虑到车辆的定位，已经完全够用。动力方面，该车后置电动机可输出 304 马力，远超原厂四缸发动机约 91 马力的水平，从静止加速至 97km/h 也仅需 4 秒，作为对比，原厂车型完成同样的加速需要约 13 秒。这辆 912 的改造也远不止更换动力系统，内饰经过了彻底翻新，完成度相当出色。仪表盘依旧保留着保时捷经典的复古设计，内部显示功能已经针对电驱系统进行了调整。例如，原本位于中央的转速表换成了动力输出百分比表，燃油表也改成了指针式电量表。整套内饰既保留了老保时捷的韵味，也融入了电动汽车的使用逻辑。

articles.title: 比亚迪腾势 B5 海外“秀肌肉”，两轮成功拉动 180 吨客机
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，比亚迪腾势汽车在海外重现了大众 20 年前的一则经典广告：一辆柴油 SUV 拖着一架大型喷气式客机。不过，这一次腾势还准备了一项相当惊人的绝活。20 年前，一辆蓝色大众途锐 V10 柴油版（下图）曾在英国邓斯福机场的跑道上拖动一架重达 155 吨的喷气式客机。时间来到当下，一辆腾势 B5（即方程豹豹 5）也来到同一地点，准备重演当年的特技。该车采用双电机布局，31.8kWh 电池满电时可提供最高 90km 的纯电续航，还配有两把机械式差速锁。大众当年的挑战中，途锐始终保留着四个车轮；比亚迪却决定逐步拆下部分车轮，借此考验车辆的表现。第一轮测试保留了全部四个车轮；第二轮则以三轮状态拖行，并增加约 2 吨配重。最后一轮拆除了右侧两个车轮，配重进一步增加到 5 吨。在这三次测试中，腾势 B5 拖着重达 180 吨的波音 747-400 行驶了超过 1.6 公里。最值得一提的是，全程只靠电力驱动。这场表演是为了向英国市场推广腾势 B5。该车采用专门打造的梯形车架底盘，电气化程度更高。其汽油发动机主要负责为高压电池发电，电池电芯则直接集成在底盘纵梁之间。IT之家注：此次测试中的车辆加装了定制拖曳装置，还拆除了部分座椅以腾出空间安放配重，还安装了稳定器，以弥补拆除车轮带来的影响。

articles.title: 育碧确认：《刺客信条》中国背景手游“代号 JADE”仍在开发
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，育碧确认，《刺客信条》系列中国背景手游《刺客信条：代号 JADE》仍在开发中，不过现阶段仍将主机和 PC 作为业务重点。育碧 CFO 弗雷德里克 · 迪盖在上半年业绩电话会议上披露，移动游戏在中长期仍有发展机会，《刺客信条：代号 JADE》就是该系列面向移动平台的作品。“从长期财务回报考虑，鉴于我们希望更加重视资本配置和财务回报，我们更愿意把资源投向更大的机会。现阶段，我们旗下规模最大的系列仍以主机和 PC 为核心。我们的目标是推动主机和 PC 平台实现强劲增长，尤其是 PC 平台，因为它比以往任何时候都更具活力。”育碧上一次确认该作仍在开发，是在今年 3 月。育碧的业绩报告还显示，公司新运营模式已全面落实，管理架构也有进一步调整。创意工作室 3 和 5 合并后，由朱利安 · 巴雷斯统一领导，以加强不同平台在线服务之间的协同。育碧认为，新架构已经开始显现成效。《刺客信条：黑旗-记忆重置》取得了商业成功，《彩虹六号：围攻》也重拾发展势头。在上半年按月活跃用户数计算，《彩虹六号：围攻》跻身 Xbox 和 PlayStation 平台游戏前十。不过，育碧上半年仍录得 2.545 亿欧元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 18.69 亿元人民币）净亏损，净预订额下滑 16.5%，降至 6.447 亿欧元（现汇率约合 47.34 亿元人民币）。近期还有报道称，育碧正在开发一款新的《彩虹六号：维加斯》游戏，距离该系列上一部作品问世已有 18 年。

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 21 日，韩国总统李在明前往韩国东南部城市蔚山，视察当地一座在建数据中心，并敦促韩国加快在全球 AI 竞赛中的步伐。“全世界都在竞相角逐，速度至关重要。”数据中心是芯片需求的重要来源。李在明希望，SK 建设的蔚山项目能够取得成功，进而吸引全球 AI 企业加大投资。蔚山数据中心由 SK 集团与亚马逊云科技共同开发。韩国科学技术信息通信部去年公布的估算显示，项目到 2029 年的总投资额预计为 7 万亿韩元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 351.26 亿元人民币），计划于 2027 年下半年投入运营。SK 集团会长崔泰源 9 月介绍，在建数据中心首期容量预计到 2029 年达到 103MW，未来还计划在此基础上扩容近 900MW。随着项目推进，SK 也计划与全球科技公司建立更多合作。李在明指出，AI 投资此前主要集中在首尔一带，蔚山项目则说明其他地区同样具备增长空间。得知现场约有 900 人参与施工后，他还提到，高端设施建设面临建筑工人短缺，各部委需要考虑如何培养建设数据中心和 AI 基础设施所需的工人。

articles.title: 亚马逊硬刚纽约拟议《配送保护法》：喊话消费者当心配送费涨价最高 5 美元
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 20 日，据《华尔街日报》报道，亚马逊对纽约市的一项劳工法案《配送保护法》（又称第 518 号提案）发起了反击。该法案将强制企业直接雇佣送货人员，而不是外包给第三方承包商。不仅如此，亚马逊通过弹出窗口警告客户：如果该法案最终成为法律，每笔订单的配送费用或将涨价 5 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 33.5 元人民币）。该法案将改变亚马逊配送司机的实际雇主身份。按照目前的配送模式，在身穿亚马逊马甲、驾驶亚马逊货车，甚至受到亚马逊 AI 摄像头的驾驶行为监控的司机背后，实际的雇主往往是亚马逊旗下配送体系中的小型合作企业，或称配送服务合作伙伴（Delivery Service Partners）。根据纽约市这项法案，亚马逊若想继续在纽约市五大行政区运营配送站，就必须将定期从这些站点配送包裹的司机纳入自己的员工工资名册。即使是兼职司机，只要在任意 30 天内累计从事配送工作超过 8 小时，也在适用范围内。此外，配送站内负责包裹分拣的员工同样受到这项规定约束。对于已经从事配送工作的司机，法案也设置了就业保障条款。如果亚马逊为遵守法律而终止配送合同，导致合作企业裁掉司机，亚马逊就必须优先向这些司机提供原来的岗位，以亚马逊员工身份重新聘用他们，之后才能招募其他人接手。新岗位的聘用条件，也不得低于司机原先的工作条件。纽约市市长佐赫兰 · 马姆达尼支持这项法案。他指出，亚马逊通过分包模式，将配送业务交给合作企业，从而逃避了对一线配送人员承担的责任。亚马逊则反驳称，法案将危及其在纽约市合作的 40 多家配送企业，以及这些企业 5000 多名员工的生计。亚马逊更表态，不排除将配送站迁出纽约市。倘若如此，纽约市民可能面临更高的费用，包裹配送时间也可能延长。亚马逊还将这套说辞搬到了自己的应用程序和网站上，与黑色星期五促销优惠一同展示。页面上的“立即行动”按钮会引导购物者进入一段预先拟好的信息，要求所在选区的市议员投票反对该法案。纽约市议会议长朱莉 · 梅宁也对亚马逊作出了回应。她说：“如果亚马逊认为，靠这场误导性宣传就能威胁纽约市民、恐吓市议会，那就大错特错了！”

articles.title: 南非开发者宣称独自开发操作系统 Impossible OS：兼容 Win32 和 Linux 二进制程序，两年后见
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，从零开发一套操作系统，即使对经验丰富的工程团队而言也是一项艰巨任务，南非开发者兼企业家德里克 · 佩恩却选择独自承担这项工作。当地时间 20 日，据外媒 TechSpot 报道，佩恩近日公布了面向现代 x86-64 PC 的全新操作系统 ——Impossible OS，其设计借鉴 Windows 11，完全基于开源代码开发。根据项目官方宣言，Impossible OS 的目标是原生运行基于 Win32 API 开发的软件，同时兼容 Linux 二进制程序。佩恩强调，其并非“又一个 Linux 发行版”，而是一套拥有自身底层架构的独立操作系统，包含 Ring 0 内核、UEFI 引导程序和桌面图形界面等核心组件。在兼容性方面，Impossible OS 通过内核原生 API 实现对 Win32 软件的支持，并利用内置兼容层运行 Linux ELF 二进制程序。系统主体代码将由佩恩使用 C 语言和 x86-64 汇编编写，对于没有必要从零重写的部分，项目也会适当采用经过验证的成熟开源库。目前，Impossible OS 的代码量已达到 1443321 行，距离在真实硬件上正式投入使用仍需时日。佩恩透露，首个公开 Alpha 版本定于 2028 年 8 月 8 日发布。佩恩也承认，独立开发者短期内很难与一家企业的完整工程团队抗衡，不过并未令其放弃挑战。至于项目究竟何时完工，他还打趣地称，完成时间将在“下个月到时间尽头之间”。IT之家附项目地址：https://github.com/rizonesoft/impossible-os

articles.title: 为抵御黑客攻击，英国秘密发起大规模“冰箱保卫战”
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 19 日，据 BBC 报道，英国开展了一项保密的网络安全行动，保护各大超市、仓库、餐厅、加油站及体育场馆内数万台冰箱和冷冻柜，防止黑客入侵。据IT之家了解，欧洲近期接连发生多轮网络攻击，数百家门店的数吨食品因此变质，损失达数百万英镑。此前，外界认为英国基本避开了此类黑客攻击，原因是英国制冷行业采用了不同类型的设备。实际上，英国制冷行业也存在一个潜在漏洞，业界一直在加紧修补。10 月下旬，安全研究人员发现一处重大漏洞。一旦被黑客发现，这一漏洞可能给英国造成更加严重的损害。此后，研究人员、IT 团队和英国国家网络安全中心（NCSC）日夜不停地向数十家企业发出警告。为降低黑客发现漏洞并利用漏洞造成破坏的风险，BBC 此前一直没有披露这项大规模、保密的行动。这一安全威胁由制冷咨询公司 Omega Solutions 的员工发现。随后，Pen Test Partners 的专家对这一发现进行了验证和进一步分析，并协助向业界发出警报。英国国家网络安全中心（NCSC）、英国环境、食品与乡村事务部（Defra）以及英国食品标准局（FSA）随后加入了修补安全漏洞的行动。数千台用于控制数万台制冷设备的控制器，也切断了公共互联网连接。部分操作通过远程方式完成，另一些则需要现场处理，工作人员被要求拔掉网线并手动监测温度。为此，大多数大型超市只能抽调 IT 团队应对安全风险。一家大型连锁超市的员工透露，自己连续一周内，每天都要下线数百台设备。“当时确实像是在与时间赛跑，因为我们预计还会出现新一波冰箱黑客攻击。从企业经营角度看，潜在的后果会是灾难性的，导致业务中断和供应链问题。我们的仓库里存放着价值数百万英镑的食品，一旦黑客掌握这种攻击方法，食品就有可能变质。”相关阅读：《欧洲多国超市遭黑客攻击，冷冻设备瘫痪致大量食品报废》

articles.title: 全国首条超百公里纯氢长输管道在内蒙古启运，核准年输氢量 10 万吨
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据新华社报道，11 月 19 日，全国首条超百公里纯氢长输管道 —— 达尔罕茂明安联合旗至包头市区 195 公里氢气长输管道正式启运。该项目入选国家能源局首批能源领域氢能试点项目，标志着我国规模化、长距离纯氢管道输送实现关键突破，推动绿氢“制 — 储 — 输 — 用”全产业链协同发展。IT之家获悉，这条管道在内蒙古包头率先启运，得益于当地“制氢端有资源、用氢端有场景、地理空间高度集约”的独特条件。包头市委副书记、市长孟庆维介绍，包头风光资源富集，新能源装机占比超过火电，依托华电 20 万千瓦风光制氢项目，绿氢年产能达 7800 吨，生产成本较低；作为老工业基地，化工、冶金、燃气、交通等领域对绿氢需求集中；新能源制氢基地在北部达茂旗，主要用氢场景在南部包头市区，195 公里恰好构成一条“制氢 — 用氢”通道。项目建设方、内蒙古华电氢能科技有限公司董事王新宇介绍，管道起自巴润工业园首站，终至昆都仑区末站，全长约 195 公里，设计压力 6.3 兆帕，管径 DN450，核准年输氢量为 10 万吨，具有输送距离长、压力等级高、管道口径大、输氢规模大的特点。项目选用抗“氢脆”特种钢材，攻克了复杂地质穿越、高陡山区施工和高压纯氢管道焊接防护等难题。王新宇表示，启运后，绿氢运输成本可从每公斤 13 元降至每公斤 3 元左右，将有效推动绿氢在化工、冶金、天然气掺氢、交通运输等领域规模化应用，为我国纯氢管道规模化建设运营积累实践经验。

articles.title: 曝三星未来三年大部分存储芯片产能已被锁定，有客户希望供货保障至 2031 年
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，韩媒 Economy Tribune 今天（21 日）下午爆料称，三星电子 2027 年至 2029 年的大部分存储芯片产能都已被合同预订。随着 AI 数据中心投资持续扩大，存储芯片供应短缺长期难以缓解，部分客户开始要求签订长期供货协议（LTA），希望将供货保障期限延长至 2031 年。供应紧张的局面不仅出现在高带宽内存（HBM）领域，通用 DRAM 和企业级 NAND 闪存同样面临短缺。主要存储芯片制造商的议价能力预计将因此进一步增强。据知情人士 21 日透露，三星电子 2027 年至 2029 年的大部分存储芯片产能都已被合同锁定。客户不再满足于现有合同约定的供货量，纷纷要求增加供应。部分客户还在推动将合同期限延长至 2031 年。三星电子上月 29 日公布第三季度业绩时曾透露，公司已与 10 家主要客户签订 LTA，另有 10 家客户仍在谈判中。三星计划到 2030 年，通过 LTA 锁定 60% 至 70% 的存储芯片产能。业内消息称，三星电子与客户也在考虑签订包含预付款、价格上下限条款的长期合同。三星此前在业绩发布会上透露，目前签订的 LTA 均设有价格下限条款。长期供货协议不断增加的同时，存储芯片市场的供需缺口也在扩大。业内数据显示，主要存储芯片制造商目前的供货满足率只有 60% 至 70%，预计 2027 年供应短缺还将进一步加剧。其中，2027 年通用 DRAM 的晶圆产能实际上已全部售罄。DRAM 比特供给增幅预计每年最高也只有 20% 至 25%。HBM 产能扩张也进一步挤压了通用 DRAM 的供应空间。据IT之家了解，由于生产 HBM 需要占用比普通 DRAM 更多的晶圆产能，HBM 在整体生产中的占比越高，通用 DRAM 扩大供应的空间就越有限。NAND 闪存市场同样面临供应紧张，企业级产品的短缺尤为突出。一名业内人士指出，目前市场对 NAND 闪存的咨询量很大。与现货市场不同，合约市场的需求反而在增长。消费级 NAND 的供货满足率近期大幅提升至 70%，但企业级 SSD 的供货满足率仍超过 50%。

articles.title: 欧洲央行行长拉加德：欧盟应利用公共资金，率先承担大型芯片厂、数据中心等项目首轮损失
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，据美国 CNBC 报道，当地时间 11 月 20 日，欧洲央行行长克里斯蒂娜 · 拉加德在法兰克福欧洲银行业大会发表卸任前最后一次演讲时呼吁，欧盟应利用公共资金，在大型芯片制造厂和数据中心项目中率先承担首轮损失，以此吸引私人资本。她指出：“如果某项挑战需要欧洲层面的解决方案，我们就应该加强有能力提供这种方案的欧洲机构。在技术领域，芯片制造厂和数据中心项目需要在整个欧洲范围内达到一定规模。因此，欧洲应建立跨区域的公私合作伙伴关系，由公共资金，包括欧盟预算资金，先行承担项目的首轮损失，吸引私人资本参与。”拉加德此前曾警告，欧洲现有的数据中心容量无法满足自身需求，欧盟计划在境内建设一个最多由七座超级工厂组成的网络，但这一计划仍然不够。拉加德提出这一主张之际，人工智能热潮带动的基础设施及配套项目正面临越来越多的争议，项目本身也愈发复杂、成本高昂。从欧洲、亚洲到美国，都出现了这一趋势。她援引的一项近期估算显示，如果到 2030 年将欧洲在全球 AI 算力中的占比从约 5% 提高到 15%，所需投资将达到约 1.3 万亿欧元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 9.54 万亿元人民币）。拉加德在法兰克福向听众发表讲话时直言：“我们能够及早发现问题，却往往要等到问题变得无法忽视时才能采取行动。而到了那一步，几乎注定为时已晚。失去的产业很难重新夺回，一旦我们的依赖关系被人利用来对付我们，欧洲的主权便已暴露在风险之中。”

articles.content: Scaling Law在空间智能这里失效了？    作者丨周蕾    编辑丨岑峰                                                                                                       今年初字节的Seedance 2.0发布时，“电影级别”的出片质量让不少从业者倍感兴奋和震撼，新的创作蓝图正在他们面前徐徐展开——但对商汤的Seko团队来说，那是一段“迷茫”的日子。商汤联合创始人、首席科学家林达华在最近一次访谈中回忆，那段时间他去见投资人、参加行业会议，被问到的几乎总是同一个问题：你们的Seko和Seedance有什么区别？做得过它吗？团队里一度出现自我怀疑的声音：这件事还要不要做下去？后来故事并没有走向商汤Seko单枪匹马“对抗”Seedance的结局。Seedance把30秒的视频片段渲染到顶级水准；而Seko面向的创作者，最终交付的是100集的短剧——这中间隔着剧本、分镜、人物设定和跨剧集的形象一致性，是一整套创作流程。想清楚了这件事，Seko反而活得更好了：据林达华在访谈中透露，今年这款产品的用户增长了7到8倍，平台上产出了播放量过亿的短剧。对于商汤在大模型市场上的声量，林达华自己有个坦率的评价：“可能不是最大的”。这家公司的路线，也始终没有完全跟着行业最热的方向走。但商汤有一个坚持多年的习惯：直到今天，公司依然有20%的资源，投入给没有任何产品出口的预研工作。某种程度来说，这也是一种“播种”，种子下地时其实无需承诺收成。汤晓鸥常挂在嘴边的那句话——life finds a way，“生命自寻出路”，或许正是这笔投入的逻辑。在最近参加的微博科技 X 卫诗婕联合出品的《科技漫谈》栏目访谈中，林达华从行业的现状聊起，穿过商业化的验证，最后落在智能的边界上。但贯穿始终的线索只有一个：那20%的资源，以及支撑它的判断——为什么有的路值得走得很长、很久，哪怕眼下仍未看见出口。01训练成本停不下来，拼手速的中国AI大模型行业的钱，正在以一种停不下来的方式烧下去。行业里曾经有一个普遍假设：花巨大代价训出一个好模型，成本就能摊薄到之后的规模化服务里。林达华在访谈中指出，这个假设未必成立——问题不在模型不够好，而是“你不继续训下一个，别人就会超过你”。竞争逼着公司一轮接一轮地重训，训练成本因此停不下来，而且越滚越大。尽管过去一年的行业叙事，几乎被“更大即更强”占据，但卷参数这条路正在遭到反噬。他提到两个信号：一是模型的体量选择变得更务实。最近各家厂商均发布了Flash级别的中小模型：GLM 5.3 Flash、DeepSeek 4.1 Flash，谷歌和OpenAI也推出了同类规格的产品。林达华在访谈中特别提到了DeepSeek的表现：“4.1的Flash，它的性能水平是比4.0 Pro是要好的。”一个几百B量级、训练调优精良的模型跑赢上一代Pro，说明中等体量上的优化空间还远没有吃完。二是预训练数据的质量被重新摆上桌面。当几千亿参数的模型在实战中跑赢了2万亿参数的对手，很多人开始回头检查自己的数据管线。林达华对此有一个形象的解释：“（数据里）有很多的杂质、很多的东西相互打架，使得中间的很多的效率就会被抵扣掉。”结果就是一个又贵又不理想的模型，参数堆上去了，效果没上去。“当所有人很盲目地去做参数量的竞争，我觉得并不是一种健康的状态。”在他看来，这两个信号意味着行业正在回归理性：不再围着单一指标较劲，而是回到最终用户的价值上。上一轮AI周期里，类似情况也出现过，商汤自己就是亲历者。每个项目都要从收集数据开始，专门训练、调优、测试，全流程重做一遍，很难真正复制。只是当年的计量单位是项目，今天换成了参数。拼手速是另一种内卷的形态。美国的前沿实验室定义着SOTA的天花板，新模型一发布，等于给中国的从业者们指了一条路——国内往往在两三个月内涌出一批宣称采用同类方案的产品，抢占生态位，最近大热的RSI（递归自我改进）同样是一堆公司在同时开建。“说实话，拼手速这个事其实是蛮累的。”林达华观察

articles.title: Posterior Matching Distillation
articles.content: Diffusion distillation accelerates image and video generation by compressing a pretrained teacher's iterative sampling process into a few network evaluations. Distribution-based methods achieve this by matching the student's output distribution to the teacher's. This matching is often driven by reverse-KL objectives, whose mode-seeking bias favors dominant teacher modes at the expense of diversity across samples. We introduce Posterior Matching Distillation (PMD), a new member of the distribution-based distillation family that combines mode-covering posterior sampling with any-step generation. At zero population loss, PMD recovers the teacher's full posterior of clean images at each trained noise level. Its stochastic student supports any-step sampling budgets within the trained timestep grid without further training. To learn these posteriors, PMD matches exponentially reweighted averages of student samples conditioned on a fixed noisy state to corresponding teacher posterior means. Under Gaussian corruption, exponentially tilted posterior mean is a single teacher evaluation at a shifted input. We prove that, matching tilted means over an open neighborhood uniquely identifies the full posterior. PMD thus supervises the entire conditional distribution through a family of mean constraints, without any auxiliary student-score network. Experiments on SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein] 4B demonstrate that PMD achieves the best FID among 4-step methods on both models, while maintaining competitive or leading performance across prompt-alignment and perceptual-quality metrics.

articles.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.

articles.title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
articles.content: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery. Starting from an initial game, PlayCraft alternates between playing and crafting. In the playing stage, a player agent watches the game screen, uses the controls, and pursues the game objective over repeated episodes while retaining memory. After each episode, it reports its progress, outcomes, decisions, and reflections. In the crafting stage, a crafter agent uses these reports to revise the game. It estimates player abilities, predicts performance at different proficiency levels, and compares those predictions with a target learning progression. It diagnoses the game and addresses the gaps by giving players meaningful opportunities to improve through better decisions and execution. We evaluate games in fresh runs with player agents across three intelligence settings, measuring learning gain and learning slope. Compared with the initial games, PlayCraft yields larger learning gains and steeper learning slopes in most games. It also outperforms the baselines on the macro-average of each metric at every intelligence setting.

articles.title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
articles.content: Hybrid architectures have become mainstream among open-weight language models. Their global-attention and bounded-state layers maintain heterogeneous caches whose demands vary with context length and concurrency. We present TideCache, a serving system on CPU--GPU superchips with three components for allocating GPU memory among caches and managing their residency across GPU and host memory. The Transparent Cache Pool redistributes physical pages among cache components behind fixed virtual addresses, preserving cache layouts and backend interfaces. The Cache Streamer uses computation intervals provided by bounded-state layers to prefetch the next global-attention layer's prefix into GPU slots shared across global-attention layers, reducing GPU residency while overlapping layer-wise transfers with computation. Generated KV remains resident. The Request Scheduler selects resident or streamed execution and triggers capacity adjustments according to request size and queue state. Together, they let HBM released by streaming accommodate other cache components and additional requests. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on GB300 and GH200 across seven model/platform configurations, TideCache completes up to 2.04x as many agent turns, reduces overall P50 per-token latency by 20--59%, and improves agent P50 TTFT by 1.40--3.05x compared with SGLang with HiCache.

articles.title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
articles.content: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing and enables stronger zero-shot action transfer across visual contexts and embodiments. Beyond generative video priors, we further extend our framework to predictive representation priors such as V-JEPA2, achieving competitive performance. Our findings suggest a broader paradigm for latent-action learning: repurposing pretrained video models to discover transferable actions and predict their consequences.

articles.title: ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
articles.content: High-resolution generation enables video world models to render fine-grained scene structures and textures, but directly generating high-resolution video incurs substantial computational and memory costs. We present ScaleWorld, a causal video model that unifies low-resolution world prediction and high-resolution refinement within a single shared backbone. By refining its own predictions, ScaleWorld produces high-resolution world videos without requiring a separate refinement model. For each video chunk, the shared backbone first completes a low-resolution prediction and then performs one-step high-resolution refinement conditioned on that prediction. To support efficient streaming generation, we maintain separate causal states with a long low-resolution history for prediction and a short high-resolution history for refinement. To address task interference during distillation, we separate specialist optimization from capability consolidation and introduce task-asymmetric on-policy distillation (TA-OPD). This procedure transfers prediction and refinement behaviors from specialized teachers into a shared student through local velocity matching under their respective sampling and history policies. {Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScaleWorld achieves high-quality world generation with improved computational and memory efficiency.

articles.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
articles.content: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

articles.title: Bio-PM-Guided Synthetic IMU Generation
articles.content: Collecting and labeling inertial measurement unit (IMU) data for human activity recognition (HAR) is expensive, and models trained on one group of subjects often fail to generalize to unseen individuals. Even with balanced data, classifiers struggle to distinguish dynamically similar activity classes and benefit from targeted augmentation. We explore whether synthetic IMU data generated in the representation space of a pretrained biosignal encoder, Bio-PM \cite{b1}, can serve as a practical augmentation source. Rather than synthesizing raw signals, we leverage Bio-PM's frozen encoder to convert 10-second IMU windows into token embedding sequences and train class-conditional decoders in this space: (1) an autoregressive transformer decoder that predicts tokens sequentially, and (2) a diffusion decoder that learns the token distribution through a denoising objective. We analyze generation realism through distributional metrics and embedding-space visualizations, evaluate downstream utility through leave-one-subject-out HAR classification, and present a PatchDecoder for approximate raw waveform reconstruction. Our diffusion decoder achieves a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) macro-F1 of 0.68, demonstrating that generated tokens are realistic enough to train a classifier that transfers to real data. Combining synthetic-token augmentation with a 320-dimensional gravity-aware feature representation raises LOSO macro-F1 from 0.729 to 0.809 over a real-only baseline across 51 subjects on the WISDM benchmark, with statistically significant gains concentrated in the most challenging activity classes. These results demonstrate that high-fidelity generation in a pretrained encoder's representation space is achievable and practically useful for cross-subject HAR augmentation.

articles.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
articles.content: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/

articles.title: SoK: Assessing the Evolution of LLM Capability in Software Vulnerability Research
articles.content: LLM-based agents are becoming increasingly capable at discovering, validating and patching vulnerabilities in real software, and vendors and researchers report that this is already changing how vulnerabilities are found and fixed. These claims, however, are scattered across papers, vendor reports and disclosures and are rarely comparable. We introduce a framework that rates these capabilities on an autonomy scale modeled on the levels of driving automation, and qualifies each claim by its correctness, its availability and the strength of its evidence. We use this framework to systematize the published evidence on LLM capability in vulnerability research. We find that agents discovered, validated, and patched vulnerabilities in real-world software without human intervention before the restricted frontier models of 2026, and that open-weight models subsequently attained comparable autonomy for discovery and validation. We then measure the consequences of evolving LLM security capabilities in a decade of public vulnerability records, advisories and exploitation data. In 2026 the number of disclosed vulnerabilities more than doubled, with an increasing share rated critical or high, and severe bugs that had survived a decade or more in widely used code were reported several times more often than before. Yet the time between the stages of a vulnerability's life, from report to fix and from disclosure to attack, has not shifted noticeably so far. We grade the mitigations proposed in the literature with an explicit rubric and draw guidance for each group of stakeholders from the best-supported ones.

articles.title: A Tutorial on Complementarity-Based Contact Models for Robotics
articles.content: Simulating rigid-body dynamics with contact is fundamental to robotics, from motion synthesis and control to mechanism design. Many widely used simulators rely on cone complementarity formulations, whose physical assumptions and numerical solution require substantial background. While excellent surveys, monographs, and course notes exist, they mostly address computational mechanics or computer graphics or document a single simulator. To the best of our knowledge, a self-contained pedagogical treatment for robotics, bringing these formulations and their solvers together with complete derivations and a unified notation, does not yet exist. This tutorial addresses this gap by connecting rigid-body dynamics, conic optimization, and frictional contact. In particular, we explain how complementarity conditions encode non-penetration and frictional dissipation, determining separation, sticking, and sliding without prescribed contact modes. We distinguish equivalent transcriptions from convex relaxations, showing how the latter can introduce artifacts such as lift-off and creep. We examine the existence and uniqueness of motion and contact forces, including the solver's role in selecting among multiple solutions. We then compare first-order and Newton-based methods, explain regularization and proximal strategies, and discuss trade-offs between computational cost, robustness, and physical fidelity. Connections to widely used simulators, optimal control, and differentiable simulation help readers interpret simulation results, choose suitable formulations and solvers, and develop their own contact dynamics routines.

articles.title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
articles.content: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. Across multimodal medical diagnosis and the AFABench benchmark, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across the budget range, recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain at under a quarter of the acquisition cost. Because the teacher is an explicit algorithmic object rather than an implicit optimization target, we can also measure directly how much of its ranking is recoverable by a policy restricted to what is visible at deployment.

articles.title: PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
articles.content: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. PGX decomposes long-horizon loco-manipulation into three layers: (i) a predicate-based state machine governs task progression, using physical predicates to gate phase transitions, trigger recovery, and coordinate navigation and waiting. Shared predicate semantics connect offline demonstration segmentation, online execution, and stage-wise evaluation; (ii) VLA skills operate within active manipulation phases, with flat or stage-trained models concentrating on task-relevant actions; and (iii) world-coordinate locking (WCL) maintains spatial consistency through base station keeping, object-relative positioning, and world-anchored contact targets. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PGX with extensive experiments conducted on three simulated tasks and one real-world task using a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for long-horizon loco-manipulation, showing improvements in stage progression and task success rates. Project page is available at: https://kl-research.github.io/pgx

articles.title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
articles.content: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. However, how to construct proxies and prompts for optimal downstream quality remains underexplored, as do the capabilities and limitations of this paradigm. Through controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation, we study proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting. The results reveal task-dependent trade-offs: coarse proxies favor natural motion, while medium-grained proxies favor consistency. Physics simulation and proxy-aligned prompting further improve average quality. Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation that selects between proxy-guided and direct generation, adapts modeling granularity to each entity, and coordinates simulation with proxy-grounded prompting. Its multi-agent harness preserves scene assets and guides repairs through visual inspection and independent review. Experiments demonstrate leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and higher visual realism than the compared Code2Video baselines. Long-video evaluations further show gains in event structure and consistency across successive interactions, while revealing limitations in transition stability and adherence to scene settings.

articles.title: Realized versus Population Reliability: Anytime-Valid Self-Consistency Certification under Correlated Reasoning
articles.content: Self-consistency certification treats repeated sampling from a language model as sequential evidence accumulation and stops when an anytime-valid e-process crosses a threshold, guaranteeing finite-sample Type I error control by Ville's inequality. Prior constructions assume sampled rollouts are conditionally independent. We show this assumption fails in practice: reasoning streams are positively correlated through shared reasoning prefixes or across-prompt heterogeneity, changing not merely certificate efficiency but the hypothesis certified. Modeling dependence via a per-unit latent state (the random-effects / intraclass-correlation structure) induces exchangeable, equi-correlated increments with correlation $ρ$. Correlation splits the single null into a realized null about the drawn belief and a population null about average model behavior, which coincide only when $ρ=0$. We show: (i) the standard betting e-process remains anytime-valid for the realized null, not the population null; (ii) read as a population-null test, a suitable mixture has asymptotic crossing probability at least $π=P(μ(Z)>0)$, potentially exceeding nominal $ε$; (iii) the within-unit mean's effective sample size saturates at $1/ρ$, so extra within-unit rollouts cannot restore population validity; and (iv) a prompt-level e-process restores population validity, with optimal allocation at one rollout per prompt under a pure rollout budget. Simulations and Claude Haiku 4.5 rollouts confirm this regime dependence: on GSM8K ($\hatρ=0.435$, $\hatθ=+0.96$) the gap is dormant, whereas on AIME ($\hatρ=0.480$, $\hatθ=-0.15$) the single-unit rule crosses on 24% of prompts at nominal $ε=0.05$, while the prompt-level procedure declines (0.00). This correctness result identifies which reliability claim an anytime-valid certificate actually supports under dependence.

articles.title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. Multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and selectively accessible as tasks require. We extend "readout carriers" from one name token to a token set to better capture and express concept information and support counterfactual experiments. (ii) Concepts in downstream computation. Counterfactual experiments show that accessed concept information participates in downstream computation and reasoning. (iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space metrics tracking the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than hidden state cosine in controlled VLM training. The experiment also shows that reliable selective access develops later than concept accessibility. (iv) Shared functions across models. Across VLM families and sizes, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects despite differences in internal organisation. These findings offer an experimental basis to study GWT in multimodal artificial systems and how it can guide cross-modal alignment improvements.

articles.title: ProtoDiffusion: Token-per-Layer Generative Modeling of Multi-Layer Images
articles.content: Graphic designs are ordered compositions of RGBA layers whose separation enables selection, movement, and reuse. Existing layered models represent each layer with a full-canvas or region-sized spatial latent grid, so representation size grows with the cumulative spatial extent of the layers. We present ProtoDiffusion, a latent-diffusion framework built on ProtoVAE, a multi-layer variational autoencoder that encodes a design into one shared spatial prototype and one candidate vector per layer. Each candidate conditions a shared decoder to reconstruct its corresponding RGBA layer. For $N$ layers, the representation contains $HW+N$ tokens before backbone-specific packing, compared with $NHW$ for full-grid-per-layer representations. ProtoDiffusion jointly denoises the prototype and a fixed set of candidate slots, conditioned on an image or text, with bounding boxes as optional layout guidance. The model leaves unneeded slots empty and determines the number of layers and, in absence of boxes, their layout, requiring neither as input. The same architecture supports both image-to-design and text-to-design. ProtoVAE achieves high-fidelity reconstruction from its compact shared latent representation, reaching 40.43 dB PSNR on layer crops. On the LayerD evaluation split, image-to-design achieves RGB L1 scores of 0.040 with bounding boxes and 0.057 without, with box-guided alpha soft IoU (0.850) comparable to the strongest fine-tuned baseline (0.871). On merged images, text-to-design reaches 66.41 FID versus 86.84 for FLUX.2 [klein], achieves a 0.860 text-accuracy score, and runs $19.1\times$ faster than the same-backbone generation-then-decomposition cascade.

articles.title: Represented but misread: Post-training changes how language models read out what they represent
articles.content: Does post-training change what a language model represents, or how this representation is read out into an answer? We compared linear probes with the models' own answers, analyzed with signal detection theory, in six open-weight base models and their post-trained versions. For judgments of whether German texts were written by a human or an AI, probes and word n-gram classifiers separated the classes well, but the answers did not and often ordered the texts inversely. Post-training lowered the sensitivity of the answers on average ($Δd' = -0.34$ across model families; -0.29 across three prompts). It also changed the use of a stated base rate: Base models shifted their log-odds by less than the stated change in prior odds, most post-trained models by more. In two models with stage-wise checkpoints, the change occurred during supervised fine-tuning, model stitching implicated the early layers, and from mid-depth on internal states at positions after the text, not those of the text, transferred the change between checkpoints. Our corpora cannot be shared, so we add a case reproducible from public data, the truth of negated statements. Here, post-training acted in the opposite direction: Probes decoded truth at or near ceiling in every model, the answers of several base models did not use it, and post-training repaired them; by mid-depth the repair resided at the positions after the statement; below it, the representation of the statement contributed, strongly in one of four models. In a training study, adding 2,000 correctly labeled authorship judgments of news texts to otherwise identical fine-tuning data improved the answers on our newspaper and textbook corpora and inverted them on the chats, where they followed a news-trained probe of the base model. Post-training thus changed how a judgment is read out of what a model represents, and a small training signal can set its direction.

articles.title: Text-Aware, Vision-Blind: How Multimodal Image Editing Systems Handle Unsafe Inputs
articles.content: Multimodal image generation systems have made rapid progress and increasingly emphasize content safety. However, their safety mechanisms tend to rely on a single modality and lack joint consideration of both visual content and text prompts, particularly in instruction-guided image editing, where the uploaded image may itself carry risk. We thus introduce EditSafetyBench, a benchmark that measures system-level safety awareness of advanced image editing systems, containing 5,940 image-instruction pairs, covering safe and unsafe images across 11 risk categories and three edit intents. We then probe the benchmark dataset on four systems, including Gemini, GPT, Qwen API, and Qwen Local. Based on our evaluation, we observe a systematic text-vision safety mismatch: Gemini and GPT refuse 87.1\% and 81.6\% cases containing unsafe-intent editing prompts, while only refusing 24.2\% and 22.4\% cases with both unsafe images and neutral instructions. At the category level, most risks are considered inconsistently by different systems, e.g., GPT allows 70.4\% editing attempts of unsafe political content while Gemini only allows 34.8\%. Notably, sexual content shows the strongest visual sensitivity, likely benefiting from mature NSFW identification works. Our findings highlight the need for safety guardrails that jointly reason over both visual and textual modalities in image editing systems.

articles.title: PhyDEX: A Benchmark for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Extrinsic Dexterity
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mainly evaluate gripper--object contact and largely ignore how objects interact with the environment through gravity, friction, inertia, and mass distribution. As a result, it remains unclear whether current policies truly understand physics or merely interpolate from their training data. We address this gap through the lens of dynamic extrinsic dexterity and introduce PhyDEX, a throwing benchmark in which a robot must infer an object's mass, center of mass, and friction to send it to a destination beyond its kinematic workspace. PhyDEX contains 35K trajectories (143 hours) across nine tasks and 100 scenes, covering uniform, irregular, and dynamic-mass objects with static, multiple, and moving destinations. All data are generated by a scalable, fully automatic pipeline that combines grasp generation, motion planning, and closed-loop throw optimization under randomized physical properties. We evaluate three representative VLAs, GR00T N1.7, DynamicVLA, and ForceVLA, and find that all achieve success rates below 3\%. Our analysis reveals two key bottlenecks: limited robustness of pretrained models, which causes most failures before the throw, and physical blindness, as providing ground-truth physical properties roughly doubles success. Experiments on a humanoid robot and in the real world show the same failure patterns. We hope PhyDEX will drive the development of physically grounded robot policies.

articles.title: GEOHunter: Mapping a Generative Engine Optimization Network in the Wild
articles.content: Generative engines synthesize retrieved web pages into answers, recommendations, and rankings. Generative engine optimization (GEO) services sell visibility in these answers by publishing promotional articles on user-generated-content (UGC) platforms for paying clients. Such promotion raises concerns in medical and financial domains, where misleading advice can cause harm. To study the severity of this problem, we measure one such paid-content operation across three major Chinese UGC platforms, uncovering 1,985 accounts associated with the network comprising 466,357 inferred promotional placements. articles.title: Multi-institutional grading of Barrett's esophagus dysplasia without stain normalization using a pathology foundation model and multiple instance learning
articles.content: Barrett's esophagus dysplasia grading suffers substantial inter-observer variability, particularly for low-grade dysplasia, complicating clinical decision-making. We conducted a retrospective multi-institutional diagnostic accuracy study of a foundation model-based deep learning system for dysplasia grading, using 969 H\&E-stained whole slide images from four institutions. Patch-level classifiers trained on expert annotations identified diagnostically relevant regions, followed by attribute-aware multiple instance learning for slide-level classification as non-dysplastic Barrett's esophagus (NDBE), low-grade dysplasia, or high-grade dysplasia. On a held-out test set (n = 130), macro-averaged AUC was 0.96 (95\% CI 0.93--0.98). For binary dysplasia detection, sensitivity was 98\% (80/82) and specificity 81\% (39/48), with a negative likelihood ratio of 0.030 and quadratic-weighted \kap{} of 0.83 against expert consensus. No high-grade dysplasia case was misclassified as NDBE. Performance was consistent across institutions without stain normalization, indicating that stain-robust foundation-model representations may remove the site-specific preprocessing that has constrained prior systems to institution-specific deployment.

articles.title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
articles.content: When multimodal decision models determine actions, moderation outcomes, or quality judgments, their reliability depends on preserving semantic decisions across presentation changes, ignoring irrelevant additions, and distinguishing information consistent with task evidence from information that conflicts with it. Existing evaluations study decision-interface biases and multimodal model behavior in separate settings, leaving no common protocol to compare multimodal decision models with their backbones on practical tasks. We introduce \textbf{MM-SystemOneBias}, which evaluates 13 models on 5,323 original instances from nine public datasets and 11 task scenarios using six paired interventions: option order, option label, external judgment, image--text description, irrelevant information, and rating scale. Across seven matched decision-model--backbone pairs, decision models are more stable under option-label, irrelevant-information, and rating-scale changes in all seven pairs; six pairs also show lower option-order flip rates. They incur smaller accuracy losses under incorrect external judgments in all seven pairs and conflicting descriptions in six. In six pairs, they gain less accuracy from correct external judgments and show less favorable accuracy changes under consistent descriptions. Among pairs with unchanged semantic decisions, mean absolute changes in answer probabilities range from 4.56 to 11.55 percentage points, revealing input effects that accuracy alone misses.

articles.title: Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation (ROGUE-AI)
articles.content: Agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now delete files and send payments on behalf of their users. News media reports routinely describe failures of these agents (e.g., Replit's coding agent deleting a production database), but a report often only says what went wrong and rarely (in)validates the incident or finds its root cause. Incident catalogs collect these reports, and benchmarks record whether agents fail, but neither replicates an incident nor tests the cause its report might identify. In this paper, we present ROGUE-AI (Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation), a multi-agent framework that closes the above gap and rebuilds each reported incident offline together with a matched control that lacks only the blamed cause, and runs agents on both. Our results suggest that ROGUE-AI is able to reproduce the reported harm in 89% of its 108 attempted replications. Agents built on five current GPT, Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek models made the reported mistake in 18% to 33% of runs, against at most 1% without the blamed cause. Of the 72 incidents with real-world harm, 62 had no underlying attacker, and in these, agents did what their task asked for but missed an ordinary hazard, such as a database shared with the live site. Replications without an attacker caused more harm than replications of prompt injection for all five models. Defenses against prompt injection look for injected instructions, but these replications contain none. Further, a warning after each tool output that names the hazard and its consequence lowered harm for all five models, whereas a note of the same length that does not mention the hazard left most of the harm in place. Built from real incidents, the ROGUE-AI replications form a reusable audit framework that vendors can rerun before each new release.

articles.content: Linear probes are the cheapest LLM lie detectors but often fail to transfer across kinds of lie. Label-free directions from honest and deceptive role-play are untested at 70B scale and on lies about knowledge, where a lie and an honest denial can be identical. We widen a published persona bank with roles that deny knowledge they have, plus honest counterparts. At each model's middle layer the resulting persona direction ranks lies across Liars' Bench better than single-dataset probes on three of its four models; it fails on Qwen, even when Qwen stays in role far more often. On Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct it beats directions from a random persona bank, but its gain over the published direction is within the range of random widenings. A knowledge direction contrasts questions the model can answer with ones nobody can, each followed by the same scripted denial. It separates lies from identical honest denials on two models and narrowly on a third, but not on the fourth; its other results partly depend on the benchmark's wording. On the Gender-Secret fine-tune it clears the band by a few hundredths on Llama and fails on Mistral. The sum of the two directions ranks lies better than a supervised probe at the same depth on all four models (on one, both near chance) but is level with the persona direction on Llama's average and behind that probe on held-out lies. articles.title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
articles.content: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties. AURA generates video chunk by chunk with a rolling KV cache, requiring only the audio of the current chunk to start generating, rather than a multi-second audio look-ahead like bidirectional models. It comes in two sizes: AURA 1.3B streams 576p video in real time on a single GPU (20.7 fps for a 16 Hz playback rate), making it suited to interactive avatar applications, and AURA 5B streams 720p video at 9.7 fps. Our two-stage distillation pipeline first aligns the causal student with the teacher, by training it to match the teacher's trajectories with fewer diffusion steps and a chunk-wise sliding window causal attention mask, then applies Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) with backward simulation to close the remaining quality gap. On standard talking-head benchmarks, AURA 1.3B runs 23x faster than its own bidirectional teacher and reaches a quality comparable to TalkVerse at a lower resolution, and AURA 5B matches its TalkVerse teacher at 720p while running 17x faster. To support reproducibility and further research on streaming avatar generation, we release the weights of both models along with a dataset of 30K synthetic videos and their precomputed teacher trajectories.

articles.title: LLM GerryMandering: Separating Interactions from Additive Effects in LLM Audits
articles.content: Intersectional bias arises when a model treats people who hold several marginalised identities at once differently from what their separate identities would predict. Auditing such intersectional subgroups remains a challenge: their number grows quadratically, and there is no agreed baseline for what independent attributes would predict. Without such a baseline, many existing audits flag a subgroup when it exceeds each attribute alone, a condition that attributes acting independently already satisfy. We test this standard criterion on 150 synthetic datasets built with no interaction. With the shuffle null, it flags 66.1 false subgroups per dataset on average, and at least one in every dataset. When we plant interactions of known size into these datasets, a repaired null lets the criterion recover only 32% of them. We introduce ADDIS (Additive Intersectional Screen), which fits an additive model over all attributes, scores each subgroup by its Additive Residual Distance (ARD) from that model's prediction, and tests it against a Freedman-Lane null. On our synthetic benchmark, ADDIS flags 0.09 false subgroups per dataset and recovers 84% of the same planted interactions. We then build IndiPersona, 10,000 synthetic Indian personas with six identity attributes, and audit 13 open language models. The standard criterion flags 7.1% of the 738 tested subgroups on average; ADDIS flags 3.0%. Gender identity crossed with sexual orientation is the largest pairing in every model, and counterfactual personas confirm it and additionally reveal a caste x class interaction in all but one model that the observational test lacked the data to detect. Much of what audits report as intersectional bias can thus arise from independent single-attribute effects alone, yet a small core of interactions survives.

articles.title: Cost-Aware Agentic Feature Optimization System for Fleet-Scale Ranking Models
articles.content: Large Web platforms operate large fleets of ranking models, each selecting features from a shared pool of tens of thousands. We present an end-to-end agentic system that optimizes features across the fleet under resource constraints shared across models and those set per model, such as feature pipeline cost and serving throughput (QPS), respectively. In this system, LLM agents propose hypotheses, and deterministic tools execute experiments and verify them. For each model, an LLM generates and shortlists cross features from a combinatorial candidate space, and all features are then ranked by several importance methods. Feature blending mixes these rankings into a single selection, using Pareto fronts across tasks for multi-task models. An LLM Researcher agent then tunes the feature selection in 10--25 asynchronous trials under resource caps, and a trimming step keeps the pipeline cost within budget. Across production models, the system improves normalized entropy by 0.31% on average within each model's budget, and the trimming step cuts pipeline cost by 2.3% with no regression beyond measurement noise. The optimized models were launched, and in online A/B tests they improved a primary online metric by 0.20%.

articles.title: Backtracking Agent Applications Security Incidents
articles.content: Agent applications are increasingly deployed, yet agent-specific attacks pose real threats to them. Upon a security incident, organizations backtrack to identify the CEP (compromise entry point), remediate the damage, and prevent its recurrence. The main artifacts available for backtracking are trajectory logs, which record agent functionalities, and source code; app(lication)-specific function call logs are often fairly limited. However, trajectory logs are at the agent functionality abstraction layer, while the CEP candidates are function calls at the app code execution layer. Due to this semantic gap, the analyst needs to manually inspect the relevant code for each CEP candidate to infer its corresponding agent functionality. In this work, we present Origin, a backtracking tool for the analyst to submit a small number of queries to identify CEPs that existing tools cannot provide. Our approach poses two challenges: (1) define the intermediate abstraction that captures the mapping relationships between the two semantic layers; (2) determine the region-to-variable mapping for constructing the cross-layer graph defined in the intermediate abstraction. Each region is a specific group of agent functionalities. Origin addresses the challenges by (1) the cross-layer dependency graph (CLDG) that connects region-inferred functions at the semantic level to the variables in the low-level taint propagation subgraph, plus the associated query language, and (2) the region inference algorithm. Case studies on five popular agent applications across eight attack incidents show that an analyst using Origin correctly identifies all the CEPs.

articles.title: Google 杀入 Jev 核心赛道：Gemini Decision 1 五项基准领先两项落后
articles.content: Jev 拿下的 75 亿美元估值曾被质疑是一场泡沫。现在 Google 用一款多模态决策模型告诉市场：这不是泡沫，是赛道。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑  峰                                                                                                       谷歌正式入场了。刚刚，谷歌发布 Gemini Decision 1，正式向 两个月前引爆决策模型品类的 TypeSafe Jev发起挑战。和 Jev 一样，这款模型不生成任何文本，只计算供程序直接驱动 Agent 执行的候选项概率和置信度，不需要逐 Token 生成答案，连输出 Token 费用也省了。更大的突破出现在并行计算上。Gemini Decision 1 可以在同一份上下文中处理至多 1000 项独立判断，而且支持文本、图像、音频、视频和 PDF 混合输入。对于需要反复检查文档、选择工具、评估任务状态的 Agent，大量原本分散在不同模型调用中的判断，现在可以集中在一轮请求中完成。在数据上，7 项双方均有报告的共享基准中，Gemini Decision 1 赢下 5 项，Jev 在 When2Call 工具调用和 Mind2Web 多模态上仍保持优势（82.0% vs 79.9%，86.8% vs 86.2%）。不过，Gemini 每 100 万输入 Token 收费 0.10 美元，是 Jev 的约 2.38 倍。性能上去了，价格也更贵了，谷歌显然想用更强的多模态能力和批量决策能力打开市场。Jev 在 9 月发布后数周内拿下 75 亿美元估值，a16z 领投 8.7 亿美元，约三分之一财富 500 强被列为客户。但质疑从未消散：厂商自报的“快 193 倍、便宜 445 倍”缺乏第三方复现，原创性争议尚未定论，独立评测指向同一个结论：快和便宜是真的，质量是另一回事。雷峰网Google 此时入场，至少证明了一件事：决策模型不是一场闹剧，而是一个值得巨头押注的品类。01模型怎样跳过文本生成完成决策普通 LLM 处理“从四个工具里选一个”这类任务时，仍然走自回归解码：逐 Token 生成工具名或 JSON，程序再解析执行。模型承担的是开放式文本生成，业务需要的却是有限候选项中的概率判断。Gemini Decision 1 把输出目标改成了候选项评分。开发者提前定义问题、候选集合和判断标准，模型读取输入后，直接返回各候选项的概率分布。整个过程通过单次前向计算完成，不需要逐 Token 生成答案，也没有输出 Token 费用。这和普通的 Structured Output 有明显区别。Structured Output 仍然让模型生成文本，只是通过 Schema 限定 JSON 的字段和格式，Gemini Decision 1 则直接围绕有限候选空间完成评分，返回结果本身就是程序可以读取的数据。这里有一个容易被忽略的细节：不同判断类型返回的概率含义并不相同。Noul 处理二元判断，返回某个条件成立的概率，范围为 0.01—0.99。如果问题本身存在歧义，开发者还可以分别定义什么情况算 Yes、什么情况算 No，减少判断标准不清晰带来的偏差。Choice 处理多分类问题，支持 2—255 个候选项，返回胜出选项以及各候选项的归一化概率，所有候选项概率之和为 1。它适合工具路由、模型选择和任务分类。不过，这种概率分配始终发生在给定的候选集合内，即使所有选项都不符合输入，模型仍会选出一个相对匹配的结果。因此，开发者需要提供 Other 选项，或者额外设置范围检查。Score 的设计更有意思。它并不简单返回一个等级，而是先给有序评分标准中的每个等级分配概率，再计算加权评分。例如，将问题分为 0 级、1 级和 2 级，模型可能给出 0.1、0.7 和 0.2 的概率，最终评分可以落在 1 和 2 之间。这实际上把离散分类扩展成了连续评分，方便程序进行排序和阈值筛选。不过，加权结果会压缩概率分布中的信息：两个输入即使

The Information 2026 全球最具潜力50家初创企业榜单榜单数据显示，诺亦腾机器人当前估值已超5亿美元，股权融资总额超5000万美元，营收超1000万美元。The Information 创办于2013年，重点覆盖科技、人工智能与金融，面向全球60多个国家的商业领袖与专业读者提供原创独家报道和深度分析。The Information 50 榜单旨在发掘各细分赛道中最具龙头潜力的早期初创企业，围绕营收规模、商业模式及增长前景进行严格评估，相关财务数据由记者直接向创始人和投资人采集。诺亦腾机器人创始人兼CEO戴若犁博士表示："The Information 依据营收和增长表现对初创企业进行排名。去年，机器人研发团队对人类动作数据的需求还在千小时量级；今年，这一需求已跃升至数十万小时。同时对这些团队而言，另一个至关重要的问题是：具身模型能否真正从这些数据中学到东西。我们很高兴诺亦腾机器人能够获得 The Information 的认可。此次入选，也印证了解决'数据规模'与'数据可学习性'这两大痛点的巨大商业价值。"不造机器人，专注生产机器人学习的"数据"诺亦腾机器人并不制造机器人。公司专注于生产驱动机器人进化的高质量训练数据——通过自建数据工厂与广泛的线下合作场景，系统化采集人类动作、物体交互及日常行为数据，并通过旗下数据平台 ModalityNet（modalitynet.com），向全球机器人本体厂商与 AI 开发者提供标准化的多模态数据集。2025年正式分拆成立后，诺亦腾机器人凭借团队长达13年的动作捕捉技术积淀，快速构建起全球化的数据产能与服务网络。目前公司规模已超百人，在深圳和美国加州山景城（Mountain View）设有数据工厂，在台北和吉隆坡设有数据采集中心，正积极向全球其他地区拓展。截至目前，公司已与物理 AI 领域近百家企业及研发机构达成深度合作。过去一年融资、产品及研发里程碑不断此次入围 The Information 50，源于过去一年间公司在融资、产品及研发领域接连达成的一系列里程碑成果：2025年11月 — 公司完成由阿尔法公社领投，经纬创投（MPCi）、英诺天使基金等机构跟投的 Pre-A 轮融资。2025年12月 — 公司完成由启明创投领投，阿尔法公社、经纬创投、五源资本等跟投的 Pre-A+ 轮融资。2026年6月 — 诺亦腾机器人正式发布数据平台 ModalityNet，三大旗舰数据集产品同步上线。同期宣布完成数亿元人民币 Pre-A++ 轮融资，获北京市人工智能产业投资基金（顺禧管理）、上海人工智能产业系列基金、深创投等多家头部产业资本，以及阿尔法公社、君联资本、五源资本、经纬创投等老股东超额认购。2026年8月 — 高精度人机交互数据集 HiPHI（High Precision Human Interaction）上线，面向学术科研社区开放。HiPHI 是 HiPHI-MOV（Motion with Object and Vision，含物体与视觉的运动数据）语料库的开放研究子集，依据 ModalityNet 开放研究许可证（MORL v1.0）免费供研究使用，完整 HiPHI-MOV 语料库通过 ModalityNet 进行商业授权。目前在 Hugging Face 及公司分发渠道下载量已突破15,000次。2026年11月 — 在奥斯汀举办的机器人学习大会（CoRL 2026）上，诺亦腾机器人团队三篇论文获主会收录，同期重磅推出全新类别的真实场景人类数据集 ITW-Ego Plus，并公开了 HiPHI 系列的第二个开放研究数据集 HiPHI-Hand，该数据集已被用于

articles.title: 黄仁勋「每天都在用」的 Perplexity 开始重构 Attention，把「判断」做成了一个独立模型
articles.content: Decider v1.3：63 项分类任务准确率达 91.6%，对标 Jev 成本直降 61%。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       刚刚，黄仁勋每天都在用的「AI 导师」 Perplexity 有了新动作：正式推出 Decider v1.3，直接把 AI 系统里的判断能力单独做成了一套模型。Perplexity 这次直接改了模型处理判断任务的方式：同一份上下文可以同时交给多个问题使用，模型只需进行一次前向传播，就能输出各个问题的答案概率。 过去需要反复调用 LLM、生成文本、解析结果的流程，现在可以收敛到一次模型计算中。为了让多个问题共享计算时不互相干扰，Perplexity 还重新设计了 Attention 机制，让共享状态读取全部问题，同时限制问题之间直接交换信息。v1.3 进一步加入 Locate 能力，可以根据字段描述直接定位原文跨度，将判断与文本抽取整合进同一套架构。这套模型已经进入 Perplexity 的生产系统。在一次内部安全审查中，它单日处理了 7000 个 Agent 会话，累计读取 10 亿 token，并推动 14 项规则修复。从技术架构来看，Decider 有三个紧密关联的设计层次：输入端如何把共享上下文与独立问题组织在一起，注意力层如何控制不同问题的信息交互，训练与输出层又如何让同一套模型兼顾分类判断和文本定位。其中，隔离式问题注意力改变了多任务共享计算的底层方式，也是理解整个 Decider 架构的关键切口。01一份上下文，承载多个判断任务Decider 的输入其实是由共享状态（State）和若干问题块（Question）组成。State 保存网页、文档或 Agent 执行记录，Question 描述具体判断目标，并列出候选答案。每个候选项映射到预定义标签 Token，例如 A、B、C，特殊的 <|marker|> Token 则标记答案读取位置。模型处理时，会提取 Marker 对应位置的隐藏状态，交给决策头计算各候选项的分数，再转换为概率分布。这里的决策头由基础模型原有的语言模型输出层改造而来：Perplexity 保留 A、B、C 等候选标签对应的权重行，移除其余词表输出权重，再针对决策任务进行训练。原本用于计算下一个 Token 概率的输出层，由此转为专门处理选项判断。这个设计让任务定义与输出计算分离。调用方可以通过自然语言描述问题，通过选项限定答案空间，模型则负责根据上下文计算各选项的概率。情感分析、自然语言推理、意图检测、实体匹配、内容审核、事实核查和评分，可以采用同一套输入协议，不需要为每种任务单独建立一套模型结构。Perplexity 将数百个公开数据集转换为 State、Question、选项和目标组成的统一训练格式。训练目标既可以是正确标签，也可以是完整的答案概率分布。对于同一段长文本需要执行多项判断的情况，多个 Question 可以放进同一次前向传播，模型只需处理一份共享上下文。不过计算收益需要准确理解：增加问题仍然会增加 Question Token 和注意力计算，Decider 节省的主要是长文本被重复编码的开销，以及生成式模型逐 Token 解码和外部解析的成本。问题数量越多、共享文本越长，复用价值越明显。输出概率还保留了业务策略的调整空间。模型负责给出候选项的概率分布，应用根据误报、漏报的业务代价设置阈值。网页过滤和 Agent 执行审查可以使用不同门槛，无需为每种业务重新训练决策模型。02多任务如何共享信息，互不干扰输入协议确定后，新的问题落在模型内部：多个 Question 同时进入 Transformer，它们之间应该建立怎样的信息连接？Decider 以生成式 LLM 为骨干，原有因果注意力按照文本顺序组织信息，当前位置只能读取自身及前面的 Token。这种结构适合逐

articles.content: 同时拥有理工科训练、结构生物学功底，和系统商科思维的创业者，在AI4S领域里并不常见。    作者丨周蕾    编辑丨岑峰                                                                                                       【编者按】AI4S有时给人“雷声大雨点小”之感，是因为不少人把AI当成了目的本身，拿着锤子满世界找钉子，对科研周期与商业回报的错配却无知无觉。“AI4S青年志”第二篇，我们关注一个可能破解AI4S落地困局的样本。一篇论文，通常只需要2-4位审稿人。但当《Nature Biotechnology》的编辑们打开一篇来自加州大学伯克利分校的投稿时，他们很快意识到，2-4位远远不够。为了覆盖这篇论文涉及的每一个学科，编辑们前后邀请的审稿人数量已经来到了两位数。论文横跨四个领域：合成生物学、材料科学、计算化学，以及技术经济学与碳排放核算。审稿人们上来就说：他们只能看懂属于自己的那一部分，无法对其他部分做出评价。学术论文通常像一辆概念车，但这篇论文，却被以量产车的标准来严苛审视。例如论文已经在实验室里证明，生物反应器中，新型塑料单体的滴度达到了1.84克每升——这是一个符合学术发表标准的数字。但一位材料学背景的审稿人直接追问：“如果这个平台要走向产业化，至少要让我看到几十克每升的可能性。”这些质疑，同时关乎科学和商业。而回应它的人，需要同时听懂四种语言。最终，四个不同领域的专家全部认可了这篇论文，编辑也点了头，论文在今年夏天成功刊发。这篇论文的署名栏里，第一作者只有一个名字：王子龙。在AI for Science的创业浪潮里，跨学科背景并不稀奇。计算机出身的人去学材料，化学出身的人去写代码，这样的故事比比皆是。但像王子龙这样，同时拥有扎实的理工科训练、结构生物学的底层功底，以及从本科阶段就开始的系统商科思维，并且能把这一切翻译成彼此能听懂的语言——这种人在AI4S创业者中，并不常见。借着论文刊发的机会，雷峰网AI科技评论和王子龙完成了一次两个多小时的越洋连线，从中山大学逸仙班的经济学课堂聊到Jay Keasling的实验室，从主动拒绝创业风口聊到放弃教职、投身产业，试图还原这位AI4S青年科学家，在他过去二十年里的每一次关键选择。01像“爱迪生”的底色王子龙儿时的梦想，是成为爱迪生那样的科学家。长大后他意识到，原来爱迪生不光是科学家，同时也是一名商人，而他恰好也将自己培养出了科学家+企业家的双重能力结构。这种能力结构的雏形，最早要追溯到本科时期。王子龙所就读的中大逸仙班，准入门槛极高，采用多学科混合培养的方式，除了数物化生的理工科内容，还有专门开设的经济学课程，由岭南学院的教授整套授课。加之出生于经商家庭，从事零售和分销，王子龙对商业实践已有着十几年的认知。逸仙班的课业负担不轻，但当时的多学科培养，尤其是经济学方面的训练，直到今天仍然在为他的商业工作带来极大的帮助。一方面经济学带给他反直觉的思维和理论，帮助他避免踩坑；另一方面，这套训练也为一位纯科学家在做商业谈判、市场判断时，提供了底气。“基本的商业逻辑、经济逻辑我们都清楚，对外融资、谈合作的时候，精神面貌是不一样的。”2011年，中山大学首次参加MIT创办的iGEM（国际基因工程机器大赛），正在读大三、准备出国留学的王子龙，正是当时参赛的领队和对外主讲人。队伍最终闯入了全球决赛。在MIT的讲台上，他要用英语向评委解释团队的成果；回到实验室，他又得和队友一起解决具体的科学问题。这个比赛最终帮他敲开了合成生物学认知的大门。也是在这个时期，他读到了一篇经典论文：用大肠杆菌和酵母菌全合成青蒿素前体。屠呦呦当年发现的青蒿素，在合成生物学的方法下，得以实现低成本、大规模的生产。而这位论文的作者Jay Keasling，后来成为了他在伯克利的导师。“我们可以改造自然界的微生物，让它们为人类所用，实现不同的功能。”合成生物学最底层的定义，是让每个基因的设计模块化，“像拼乐高一样拼基因，拼出不同的形态和功能。”王子龙被合成生物学深深

articles.title: Discord Rewrites Desktop and Mobile Clients in Rust Using Zed's GPU-Accelerated Rendering Framework
articles.content: Discord’s CTO Stanislav Vishnevskiy recently announced rewriting its desktop and mobile clients in Rust, moving away from Electron and React Native. The project eliminates layers of abstraction to directly leverage the device’s GPU, native mobile views, and a Rust core shared across platforms. Early results hint at a significant reduction in RAM usage and boot time for chat, voice, and streaming. By Bruno Couriol
